_about: Machine-testable conditions for the rows of data/problem-map/expected-outcomes.csv, keyed by row_id. Written by hand from that file's `facts` column on Nov 21, 2026; the CSV itself is frozen and is not edited. `when` is a list of alternatives; a row matches if every clause in any one alternative holds. A clause is [fact, op, value] with op in lt, le, gt, ge, eq, in. `judgement` holds the part of the condition that code can't test; a model or a person has to decide it. Rows not listed have no conditions.

mold_area_sqft.ask: About how many square feet does the mould cover?

mold_area_aggregate_sqft.ask: Adding up every room or level of the common area, about how many square feet of mould is there?

mold_on_tile_grout_caulk_only.ask: Is the mould only on the surface of tile, grout or caulk?

prior_class.ask: Has HPD already issued a mould violation for this room, and in which class?

year_built.ask: What year was the building built?

child_under_6_resides.ask: Does a child under 6 live in the apartment, or spend 10 or more hours a week there?

owner_occupied_unit.ask: Is the apartment occupied by the owner or the owner's family?

owner_actual_knowledge.ask: Does the owner know there is lead-based paint in the apartment?

lead_presumption_rebutted.ask: Has the apartment tested negative for lead paint, or been granted an exemption?

device.ask: Is it a smoke detector or a carbon monoxide detector?

detector_cause.ask: Did the tenant or someone in the household remove or damage the detector?

tampering.ask: Has someone tampered with the detector?

voucher.ask: Does the tenant have a Section 8 voucher?

child_10_or_under.ask: Does a child aged 10 or under live in the apartment?

child_10_or_under_in_building.ask: Does a child aged 10 or under live in the building?

written_request.ask: Has the tenant asked the landlord in writing for window guards?

window_fire_escape_access.ask: Does this window open onto a fire escape?

heat_season.ask: Is the date between October 1 and May 31?

hour.ask: What time of day was it (0 to 24)?

outside_temp_f.ask: What was the outdoor temperature in °F?

indoor_temp_f.ask: What was the indoor temperature in °F?

water_temp_f.ask: What was the hot water temperature in °F?

anti_scald_valve.ask: Does the tub or shower have an anti-scald valve?

no_hot_water.ask: Is there no hot water at all?

cascading.ask: Is water cascading, or soaking electrical fixtures?

leak_source.ask: Where is the water coming from: the roof or a pipe?

collapse.ask: Has part of the wall or ceiling collapsed, or is it collapsing?

hairline.ask: Is it only a hairline crack?

EO-011.judgement: The earlier Class A mould violation was not certified as corrected, or was falsely certified, and the mould is still in the same room.

EO-012.judgement: The earlier Class B mould violation was reinspected within 70 days and is still present, or was falsely certified.

EO-015.judgement: The caulk or tile is intact, there is no mould behind it, and it is not recurring.

EO-066.judgement: The building has 3 or more stories and was erected on or after April 18, 1929, or was built after 1951.

EO-069.judgement: The unit is tenant-occupied and the facts match one of the heat or hot water rows for a building with 3 or more units.

EO-082.judgement: The building is one that is required to have self-closing doors.

EO-087.judgement: The appliance was provided by the owner.

EO-088.judgement: The appliance is a gas stove.
